title: Main.java — demoComposite() (Composite)
text:
=================================================
  Pattern 7: Composite
=================================================
awardXp(50) on a league reaches every hero -- structure is transparent.

Structure:
  + Team "Justice League"  (total XP:0)
    + Team "Team Alpha"  (total XP:0)
      - Bolt  [XP:0, Available]
      - Titan  [XP:0, Available]
    + Team "Team Beta"  (total XP:0)
      - Orin  [XP:0, Available]
    - Dash  [XP:0, Available]

Calling awardXp(50) on the league:
  [Team] "Justice League" awarding 50 XP to all members:
  [Team] "Team Alpha" awarding 50 XP to all members:
  Bolt earns 50 XP (total 50)
  Titan earns 50 XP (total 50)
  [Team] "Team Beta" awarding 50 XP to all members:
  Orin earns 50 XP (total 50)
  Dash earns 50 XP (total 50)

After awardXp -- total league XP: 200
